traits.label: Overview
traits.text: Polypore mushroom known for its hard, woody texture and its historical use as tinder for starting fires. The fruiting bodies are perennial and can persist for many years, growing slowly and developing new layers of tubes. The fungus has also been used traditionally for making amadou, a material prepared from the flesh of the fruiting bodies and used for various purposes, including as a firestarter and as a material for hats and other items.
